name: cafe_interview
doc: Café interview: steady ambience bed but clean, well-endpointed speech (a lav mic, not a phone in the wind). Interviewer + guest trade checkable science_health claims, opinions, and filler. The ambience does NOT shred the capture, so the pipeline should recover every claim, air the settled science_health falsehoods, and drop the opinions. This is the 'the system works when capture is clean' control.

finals.text: Thanks for sitting down with me.
Of course, happy to be here.
So people always say we only use ten percent of our brains.
Right, and honestly I think coffee is the best drink ever invented.
Here is a real one though. Octopuses have three hearts.
And bananas are botanically berries while strawberries are not.
That whole place has the best pastries in the city, no contest.
Last thing. Goldfish have a three second memory.

expected_scorecard.status_note: should-pass-clean: all 4 real claims verify + air; the 3 opinions/pleasantries produce no-claim checks. (claim_recall_pct and gate_correctness_pct are NOT bounded here: the scorecard's recall denominator includes the 3 null-claim rows, and its fuzzy per-row matcher can bind a null-claim row to a neighbouring cumulative window — both are metric artifacts, not pipeline behaviour. The pipeline's actual opinion-drop is asserted via gate_distribution no-claim>=3.) Robust signals bounded: category/verdict/air accuracy on the recalled claims + the aired count + the no-claim check count.
